# Matting models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

3 matting models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: an alpha matte `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size: 1 = foreground (background removal, dichotomous / salient object segmentation).

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured. The accuracy column is lower-is-better (DIS-VD MAE).

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial | DIS-VD MAE ↓ | kernels time (ms),<br>speed-up vs original | kernels peak memory (MiB, reserved),<br>ratio to original |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`ben2`](#ben2) | yes | 0.0403 | 173, 1.2x | 2238, 0.81x |
| [`birefnet`](#birefnet) | yes | 0.0325 | 214, 1.1x | 1916, 0.99x |
| [`birefnet-lite`](#birefnet) | yes | – | 59.3, 1.3x | 960, 0.99x |

## BEN2

BEN2 (Prama LLC, 2025): cuts the foreground out of a photo as a soft mask (background removal); a Swin Transformer looks at the whole image and at four full-resolution patches and merges the views. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ben2` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 201<br>184<br>173<br>103<br>58.2 | 2466 / 2772<br>1681 / 1976<br>1946 / 2238<br>813 / 916<br>1280 / 1326 |

## BiRefNet

BiRefNet (Nankai University and partners, CAAI AIR 2024): cuts the foreground out of a photo as a soft mask at full resolution (background removal), with a Swin Transformer encoder; general and lite versions. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `birefnet` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 234<br>225<br>214<br>138<br>87.8 | 1666 / 1930<br>1660 / 1888<br>1674 / 1916<br>1874 / 1932<br>1753 / 1814 |
| `birefnet-lite` | synthetic (1080x1920) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 75.1<br>67.3<br>59.3<br>50.2<br>49.0 | 913 / 974<br>810 / 932<br>754 / 960<br>1469 / 1552<br>874 / 934 |

<details><summary>Details</summary>
